results.title: Errol Spence Jr. retires after unanimous decision loss to Tszyu
results.description: Former welterweight champion Errol Spence Jr. has retired from boxing following a unanimous decision loss to Tim Tszyu in Sydney on Saturday night. Spence, who had not fought since his ninth-round stoppage defeat to Terence Crawford in July 2023, returned after three years out but struggled with ring rust throughout the 12-round contest.

results.title: Ramazan Temirov obliterates Steve Erceg at UFC Abu Dhabi
results.description: Ramazan Temirov dropped Steve Erceg face-first with a haymaker right hand at UFC Abu Dhabi on Saturday, finishing the former flyweight title challenger at 4:21 of the opening round.
